name: std::basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator>::substr

declarations.code: basic_string substr(size_type pos = 0, size_type count = npos) const;

constexpr basic_string

substr(size_type pos = 0, size_type count = npos) const &;
constexpr basic_string substr(size_type pos = 0, size_type count = npos) &&;

intro:
Returns a substring [pos, pos + count). If the requested substring extends past the end of the string, i.e. the count is greater than size() - pos (e.g. if count == npos), the returned substring is [pos, size()).

1) Equivalent to return basic_string(*this, pos, count);.

2) Equivalent to return basic_string(std::move(*this), pos, count);.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
pos

 -

 position of the first character to include


 count

 -

 length of the substring

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: String containing the substring [pos, pos + count) or [pos, size()).

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text:
std::out_of_range if pos > size().

If an exception is thrown for any reason, these functions have no effect (strong exception safety guarantee).

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The allocator of the returned string is default-constructed: the new allocator might not be a copy of get_allocator().
